headline: How Romania Will Use the €16.7 Billion From SAFE: 35 Projects for Defense and Infrastructure. Next Tranches Depend on Milestones
summary: Romania's plan under the European SAFE instrument includes 35 projects worth about €16.68 billion for defense and infrastructure. Next tranches depend on meeting milestones.
why: SAFE is a European Union defense-lending instrument, so its disbursements shape defense procurement and infrastructure contracts for member states and their suppliers.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Cum va folosi România cele 16,7 miliarde EUR din SAFE: 35 de proiecte pentru apărare și infrastructură. Următoarele tranșe depind de jaloane
